name: znetwork_dplay_enum_connections_callback_add_service_provider_info
description: zNetworkDPlay::EnumConnectionsCallback_AddServiceProviderInfo copies DirectPlay service-provider data into a zNetworkDPlayServiceProviderInfo record and appends it to the global provider vector.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke verifies the source-level provider record and vector behavior; byte-sensitive MSVC vector insertion/EH shape remains a later tier S target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b3a0 validates the stdcall callback ABI, operator new(28), 16-byte service-provider GUID copy, _strdup(providerName->shortName), calloc(connectionDataSize, 1), byte copy of connectionData, providerFlags assignment, append into g_zNetwork_ServiceProviderList, and TRUE return.
The native smoke verifies GUID copy, duplicated display name, allocated connection blob copy, provider flags, vector append storage, and return value.
